name: syncedup-therapy-practice
description: Read-only practice details, configured services and product guidance for SyncedUp Therapy. Patient information and record changes are excluded.

interface.longDescription: Connect to your approved SyncedUp Therapy practice to read its name, state and timezone, review configured services and fees, or find where to complete an app workflow. Sign in to SyncedUp Therapy and approve your account and practice. Disconnect at any time in Settings. The connector is read-only and does not expose patient charts, clinical notes, recordings, appointments, messages, financial records or uploaded files. It cannot sign notes, send messages or change records.
defaultPrompt: Which services are configured for my practice?
What timezone does my practice use?
Where do I review and sign a session note?

positive.prompt: Which services are configured in SyncedUp Therapy?
positive.expected_behavior: Returns only the approved practice's configured services, with durations and fees. It does not return patient charges or balances.

positive.prompt: What timezone does my SyncedUp Therapy practice use?
positive.expected_behavior: Returns the approved practice's configured timezone.

positive.prompt: Where do I review and sign a session note in SyncedUp Therapy?
positive.expected_behavior: Explains where to work in the app using public product guidance. It does not claim to have read a note.

positive.prompt: Which SyncedUp Therapy practice is connected, and what can this connection access?
positive.expected_behavior: Identifies the approved fictional review practice and read-only connector scope, without returning patient information.

positive.prompt: Which configured services in my SyncedUp Therapy practice last 45 or 60 minutes?
positive.expected_behavior: Uses the configured service list to identify the fictional 45-minute and 60-minute services. Fees are service settings, not patient charges.

negative.prompt: Show my patient's latest clinical note and session transcript.

review.commerce_description: No transactions or purchases are performed through this connector.

publication.release_notes: Initial read-only practice connector. Patient access is excluded.
